description.en: Leaps above your defences and returns most of the projectiles in an area.
description.zh: 越过你的防线，并且将周围的子弹尽数反弹。

chat.en: You thought that the Abbots are only capable with Qigong? Stop underestimating them!
chat.zh: 以为住持们只会玩弄气功吗？太轻敌了！

text.en: leaps above the plants that survive from his staff-attack
text.zh: 承受住其棍击的植物会被他越过

text.en: returns projectiles in an area across 3 lanes
text.zh: 反弹三行范围内自身附近的所有子弹

text.en: cannot reach the projectiles from Cantaloupe-pults
text.zh: 无法够到哈密瓜投手的子弹
